verdict.rationale: Streaming quality is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product like AnyDesk, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents only CLI automation and the REST API for account and session management. Nothing documents adaptive quality under poor network conditions, or user controls for resolution and frame rate. Community remarks about a launch framerate benchmark and a wish to see bandwidth and codec info do not show that the capability exists.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
